title: ShelfGuard Mobile Config
description: Canonical contract for the document GET /api/v1/mobile/config serves to mobile clients (MASTER SPEC §11, TASK-533/534). Draft 07 is used deliberately, NOT the newer 2020-12 draft: the mobile client's AJV instance (mobile/features/mobile-config/validation.ts) is constructed as `new Ajv(...)` (the default export), which only understands Draft 07 out of the box — Draft 2019-09/2020-12 require importing `ajv/dist/2019` or `ajv/dist/2020` instead, which mobile does not do, and `ajv-formats` is not installed either (see "format" avoidance below). Compiling a 2020-12-flavored schema (e.g. one that used "$defs"/"prefixItems") against that default Ajv instance would throw at runtime ("no schema with key or ref" for an unrecognized $schema, or an unknown-keyword error), so this file intentionally sticks to Draft 07 keywords only ("definitions"+"$ref", not "$defs"; no "prefixItems"; no "format" keyword, since ajv-formats is absent). See TASK-533 task log for the full compatibility note. This is the SECOND, independent enforcement of the same declarative-only/whitelist-only shape MobileConfigValidator.cs enforces server-side for the pre-publish draft document (TASK-532) — kept in lockstep by backend/ShelfGuard.Tests/MobileConfig/MobileConfigSchemaContractTests.cs, which asserts this schema's enums equal MobileConfigWhitelists.cs's constants. NOTE: this schema describes the PUBLISHED/served document, which (unlike the draft ConfigurationJson TASK-532 validates) DOES include "theme" — theme is composed in at publish time (TASK-544). The "theme" sub-schema is sourced from ShelfGuard.Domain/Entities/MobileTheme.cs's typed fields plus CLAUDE CODE SPEC §10 (ЕТАП 6 Theme Editor: Logo/Primary/Secondary/Background/Surface/Text/Button radius/Card radius/Spacing preset) — NOT from MobileConfigWhitelists.cs, which has no theme concept by design. "theme.spacing" was left as a free string (no enum) pending TASK-536 (Theme domain validation + PUT endpoints); TASK-536 has now shipped and defined the authoritative spacing-preset whitelist in ShelfGuard.Application/Features/MobileConfig/MobileThemeWhitelists.cs (['compact','comfortable']), reconciled with mobile's own pre-existing placeholder guess (mobile/features/mobile-config/validation.ts already used the same two values) — this file's "theme.spacing" now enforces that same enum, kept in lockstep by MobileConfigSchemaContractTests. "navigation[].icon" was similarly left as a free non-empty string pending TASK-542 (Navigation Builder); TASK-542 has now shipped and defined the authoritative icon whitelist in ShelfGuard.Application/Features/MobileConfig/MobileConfigWhitelists.cs's NavigationIcons (['home','tag','grid','qr','ticket','map','news','user']), matching mobile's own pre-existing placeholder guess in mobile/features/mobile-config/validation.ts exactly — this file's "navigation[].icon" now enforces that same enum, kept in lockstep by MobileConfigSchemaContractTests.

configVersion.description: MobileConfigurationVersion.Version — increments per tenant, starts at 1, never reused.

theme.description: Sourced from MobileTheme.cs typed fields + CLAUDE CODE SPEC §10 (Theme Editor field list), not from MobileConfigWhitelists.cs.

spacing.description: Whitelisted preset key (MobileTheme.SpacingPreset). Enum resolved by TASK-536, matching MobileThemeWhitelists.SpacingPresets exactly (verified by MobileConfigSchemaContractTests) — reconciled with the pre-existing mobile-side placeholder guess in mobile/features/mobile-config/validation.ts, which already used the same two values.

features.description: Keys must be a subset of MobileConfigWhitelists.FeatureKeys (verified by MobileConfigSchemaContractTests). No key is required present — matches MobileConfigValidator, which accepts a partial or empty features object.

navigation.description: Bounds and item.type/item.icon enums must match MobileConfigWhitelists (verified by MobileConfigSchemaContractTests).

icon.description: Must match MobileConfigWhitelists.NavigationIcons exactly (TASK-542, verified by MobileConfigSchemaContractTests).

pages.description: Keys must be a subset of MobileConfigWhitelists.PageNames (verified by MobileConfigSchemaContractTests). No page is required present.

block.description: type enum must match MobileConfigWhitelists.BlockTypes (verified by MobileConfigSchemaContractTests). props stays loosely-validated free-form JSON, matching MobileConfigValidator — per-block-type prop schemas are TASK-538's Block Registry concern.
